blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A drug convict was arrested again in a buy-bust operation in this city on Saturday, Oct. 17, according to the local police. Lt. Col. Ryan Hernandez, Lucena City police chief, said a member of the city police drug enforcement unit, acting as a drug user, arrested the 44-year-old suspect on Saturday morning after she allegedly sold him P500 worth of meth in Barangay Ibabang Dupay. In a report, Hernandez said the suspect was caught allegedly possessing three heat-sealed plastic sachets of meth with a street value of P257,040.
